তারিখ: ১৮ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ১ জুন, ২০২২ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

National Board of Revenue: The Internal Resources Division of the Ministry of Finance serves as the administrative authority issuing customs and value added tax notifications.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the governing body responsible for overseeing the Internal Resources Division and issuing formal legal notifications regarding customs and taxation.
Internal Resources Division: This government division within the Ministry of Finance functions as the official issuing body for regulatory notifications concerning customs and value added tax matters.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend customs notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides enabling power to the government to issue regulatory orders related to tax and duty adjustments.
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with the National Board of Revenue before exercising its powers to issue or modify customs-related statutory orders.
S.R.O. 157-AIN/2019: This existing customs notification is subject to further amendment through the provisions of the current statutory order.
TABLE-I: This table is amended to replace existing entries for heading 85.41 with new entries specifying semiconductor-based transducers and other semiconductor products.
TABLE-II: This table is updated to include new entries for steel rope under heading 73.18, and to replace existing entries for universal AC/DC motors under heading 85.01 and control panels under heading 85.37.
